consequence.statement: Controller pods deployed by flux 2.7.0 simply carry the new app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux label; the release notes state no functional or operational effect from it.

assertion.statement: The flux 2.7.0 controller manifests add the `app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux` label to controller pods.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the change adds a Kubernetes label (app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux) to controller pod templates in the shipped manifests; no defined subject family (crd-field, helm-value, config-key, etc.) covers a label on rendered workload objects
